**Eritrea: how applications changed.** The extract records 992,288 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 82,234 in 2023, compared with 57,273 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 54% higher than in 2019 (37,085). Applications in 2025 were 10% lower than in 2024 (63,945). In 2025, the leading destinations were United Kingdom (9,107; 16%), Sudan (8,590; 15%), Egypt (8,439; 15%). United Kingdom received 16% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 5.5% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 88%, across 41,343 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 19% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 3.0 percentage points lower than in 2024 (91%).
